title: Andhra horror: Butcher slits friend's throat, dumps her dismembered body in lake

Following the murder, Shafi supposedly dismembered her body and disposed of the parts in a canal. Police were able to identify Kalyani through a tattoo that her relatives recognized from social media postings. Investigators have detained Shafi and his accomplice, Guruvulu, for questioning about their roles in the incident.

title: Meta now wants to sell AI to companies, hires MongoDB CEO to take on Microsoft, Google

Former MongoDB CEO CJ Desai joins as Chief Enterprise Platform Officer, reporting to Mark Zuckerberg, as Meta looks to earn a return on the over $100 billion it is spending on AI this year.

title: Rubio urges Cuba to 'choose a different path', warns of consequences
content: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio expressed hopes that Cuba will abandon communism while warning of consequences for inaction. Rubio addressed concerns over the Cuban government's refusal to change course in the face of pressure. He also discussed Venezuela, emphasizing the need for free and fair elections. Trump indicated that a US-Cuba agreement might be possible without military action.

title: Illinois company donates 50 acres around historic waterfall for new public park
content: A more than 50-acre property containing Clark’s Falls and its surrounding canyon in North Utica, Illinois, has been donated to the village by Covia. The site, documented as a scenic attraction since the early 1900s, could eventually become a public park. However, it remains closed while officials study access, safety, environmental protection, funding and long-term maintenance.

title: Study of 500 Ice Age spear points reveals how Clovis hunters managed risk
content: A fascinating study delved into the projectile points utilized by ancient Clovis and Cumberland cultures in Tennessee, analyzing nearly 500 artifacts from the late Ice Age. Findings reveal that Clovis groups often resharpened their points due to limited resource knowledge, while Cumberland groups tended to discard points with potential still intact. This suggests an evolving approach to resource management, emphasizing the growing familiarity with their environment over generations.

title: 'Godmother Of AI' Fei-Fei Li gets a 'new job'; to join AMD in $8.2 billion deal
content: AMD has announced its intention to acquire World Labs for approximately $8.2 billion. This acquisition aims to strengthen AMD's AI hardware and software development capabilities by gaining expert researchers. Fei-Fei Li will join AMD as executive vice president and chief scientist after the acquisition closes. World Labs specializes in developing advanced AI models, which are essential for evolving compute infrastructure.

title: Pills, needles, loopholes: Cops battle prescription drug abuse in Chennai
content: A significant rise in prescription drug abuse, particularly Tapentadol and Nitrazepam, is troubling authorities. Police have identified specific injection marks on youths, indicating drug misuse. Despite increased seizures, enforcement laws struggle to address the issue effectively. Traffickers have adapted their methods, moving to underground networks to evade detection. Efforts are ongoing to strengthen the legal framework surrounding these drugs and improve supply chain monitoring.

title: Conor McGregor And Ryan Garcia Spotted Singing Together In Unexpected Crossover
content: Conor McGregor and Ryan Garcia recently enjoyed a relaxed night singing together, highlighting their mutual respect. Garcia is currently in a strong phase of his boxing career after defeating Conor Benn. McGregor returned to the UFC but faced a difficult loss against Max Holloway after a long absence. Their interaction the other night provided fans with a different perspective on both fighters.

title: Esteban Ocon's F1 Future In Doubt As Ferrari Junior Emerges In 2027 Haas Twist
content: Esteban Ocon's future in Formula 1 faces uncertainty as reports suggest he may be replaced by Rafael Camara. Following Ocon's recent performance, he expressed his belief in his capabilities and stated that discussions about his future are ongoing. Meanwhile, Haas is considering various drivers for the 2027 season, including Camara, while Ocon may explore opportunities outside of F1.

title: 10 years of surgical strikes: The night India hit back after Uri attack
content: India marks a decade since the surgical strikes of September 29, 2016, which defined its counter-terrorism strategy. The operation targeted terror launch pads in Pakistan-occupied Kashmir in response to the Uri attack. This marked a significant shift towards visible retaliation against terrorism after years of restraint. Similar strategies were applied in subsequent operations like Balakot and Operation Sindoor.

title: Travel firm asks for additional Rs 2.98L to change flight dates; ordered to pay Rs 5.43L
content: A Delhi district consumer commission ruled in favor of a family against a travel company. They demanded a hefty Rs 2.98 lakh for rescheduling flight tickets, which was not disclosed before purchase. The family initially booked four open air tickets for a round trip to Amsterdam. The commission found that the travel company misled the family about fees and charges.

title: Minneapolis residents form cooperative to buy 6 historic Victorian houses
content: Residents of Nicollet Island are taking a united stand to purchase their cherished homes currently up for sale by TCHDC, due to financial strains affecting the nonprofit's ability to manage the properties. To safeguard affordable housing and the community's continuity, the Nicollet Island Cooperative has emerged. They are working alongside Land Bank Twin Cities to establish a buy-back arrangement, ensuring a stable future while negotiations with the property managers continue.

title: Bruce Willis built Caribbean compound on 7.3 acres, sold it for $27 million
content: Bruce Willis has finalized the sale of his expansive 7.3-acre beachfront estate on Parrot Cay for a staggering $27 million. Acquired in 2000, the land saw the addition of three custom built homes over four years, nestled within 12 bedrooms and 14 elegant bathrooms. With luxurious outdoor spaces featuring multiple swimming pools, this sale marks a record-breaking residential deal in the Caribbean, as Willis actively streamlines his property portfolio.

title: Gadkari: Rs 61,500 cr highway to link Siliguri, Guwahati, Shillong; UP-North East
content: The project is estimated to cost Rs 61,500 crore. The road transport ministry has also initiated an expressway connectivity project between Gorakhpur in Uttar Pradesh and Siliguri. Once these projects are complete, a high-speed highway connectivity will be established between Uttar Pradesh and the North East.

title: IPL: Mohit Sharma set to join CSK as bowling coach
content: Mohit Sharma is set to join the Zaheer Khan-led Chennai Super Kings (CSK) support staff as the bowling coach starting next season. The ex-India seamer spent four seasons with the franchise across two stints.

title: North Carolina land trust saves 200 acres around Tuckertown Reservoir

This endeavour was made possible through contributions from over 1,400 supporters and outdoor industry partners. Nevertheless, nearly 3,800 acres remain vulnerable, highlighting the trust's commitment to acquiring additional properties for public enjoyment.

title: 1920 Maryland factory restored as business hub with $1 million oyster center
content: A Maryland factory built in 1920 and later linked to the Phillips Packing Company has been transformed from a vacant site into a business and community hub. The Packing House now hosts offices, retail and event spaces, while a $1 million state project is creating an oyster-focused centre for processing, biotechnology, education and ecological stewardship.

title: Scientists test 16 Asian elephants with hidden fruit; they learn to follow box
content: In Thailand, Asian elephants demonstrate remarkable adaptability in their feeding behaviors when encountering challenges. Studies indicate that these elephants can switch from direct feeding techniques to indirect methods as needed. While older elephants may find such adaptations more difficult due to slower reflexes, the ability to change tactics is crucial for their social dynamics. This insight into their behavioral flexibility could significantly improve strategies for harmonious coexistence with humans.

title: Pushpak Pujari lost his father in Class 10; how he secured AIR 183 and IIT Delhi
content: Pushpak Pujari improved his IIT entrance rank from AIR 2,790 to 183 after choosing to prepare largely from home rather than move to Kota for coaching. Having lost his father in Class 10, Pujari stayed with his family, while his mother supported his late-night study sessions. After his first attempt, he balanced college with another year of preparation, sacrificing trips and festivals. His second attempt earned him admission to IIT Delhi’s Electrical Engineering programme.

title: Political motive behind LPU unrest? Ex-Punjab CM makes big claim
content: Students of Lovely Professional University (LPU) in Punjab’s Phagwara went on a rampage on Sunday, vandalising property and blocking NH-44 during protests over claims that an outsider raped a female student on the university campus. The protests later turned violent as students clashed with police, damaged and set fire to vehicles, and pelted stones at security personnel. Several policemen were injured.

title: Minnesota picks 57-acre site for $1 billion horticulture world fair

Organisers have secured a purchase agreement for 57 acres, while more land is expected to be assembled for the six-month event. Plans include pavilions, gardens, an amphitheatre and developments intended to remain after the Expo.

title: Century-old Texas girls camp puts 749-acre riverfront property up for auction

The camp's owners plan to auction off property and other assets to repay creditors. Victims' families oppose the sale, demanding accountability and transparency concerning the camp's operations. Investigations revealed negligence in the camp's response to a flash flood alert prior to the incident.

title: NHRC issues notice to Meta, MeitY, Etah district admin over 'exploitation' of minors
content: NHRC seeks reports over alleged use of minors in scripted social media videos in UP’s Etah NEW DELHI: . a bench headed by a member of the national human rights commission issued notices seeking action taken reports within two weeks . the complaint raised concerns over the children’s dignity, privacy, psychological well-being, parental consent and possible exploitation .

title: Karachi football team ambushed on Balochistan highway, robbed at gunpoint
content: a football team travelling from Karachi to Quetta was robbed at gunpoint . armed men intercepted the team's bus between Mastung and Sariab . the incident took place on a highway in pakistan's Balochistan province .

title: Puja after paribartan: What is changing in West Bengal’s biggest festival
